narr: Thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to northern Monmouth County on the evening of July 14. Rainfall amounts of 1.5 to 2.5 inches fell in a short amount of time.
ev: Flooding at Front Street and Broad Street in Keyport with road closures.
Widespread roadway flooding occurred in Union Beach with numerous roads becoming impassable. Several roads were closed including Florence Avenue, Pine Street, Park Avenue and Ocean Avenue.
